name: GyroAim
description: Gyro aiming in any game: the controller's gyroscope drives the stick, tuned from your phone while you play.
author: jmelovich
release_notes:
Initial release of GyroAim for PS5, tested only a handful of titles.

Installing
Unpack PPSA99510.zip into /data/homebrew/ on the console, then launch GyroAim from the home screen and choose start the service. The app carries the service inside it, so there is nothing else to install.

What you need
- A jailbroken PS5 with an ELF loader on port 9021 and kstuff loaded.
- ShadowMount+ to register the title, and new enough to mount /data if you want the service to start with the console.

Settings
The panel shows a QR code for the settings page. Open it on a phone on the same network and tune the aiming while you play.

Experimental homebrew. It writes into a running game: save first. Not affiliated with Sony. Contains no licensed code.
